title: Living abroad
instructions: Radyoda Japonya'da yaşayan bir İngilizle röportaj. Uzun bir diyalog; geçmiş, zorluklar ve planları ayırt et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Today I'm talking to James, who moved from London to Osaka. James, when did you move?

script.speaker: james
script.text: Five years ago. I went for one year to teach English, but I loved it, so I stayed.

script.speaker: host
script.text: What was the most difficult thing at first?

script.speaker: james
script.text: The language. I couldn't read anything, not even the signs at the station. I got lost all the time!

script.speaker: james
script.text: Now I can speak quite well, but reading is still hard. There are thousands of characters.

script.speaker: host
script.text: What do you like most about living in Japan?

script.speaker: james
script.text: The food, definitely. And it's very safe. I once left my wallet on a train, and someone gave it to the station.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Do you miss anything from home?

script.speaker: james
script.text: My family, of course. And sometimes I miss a good English breakfast!

script.speaker: host
script.text: Are you going to stay in Japan?

script.speaker: james
script.text: For now, yes. Next year I'm starting my own language school here.
